== Story 636: primary-source comparison ==
[[Media:Decipher Glossary Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement (updated 29 January 2002)]], PDF p. 4. The Supplement explicitly replaces only the last test line with Place on apprentice. All opponent’s Force drain bonuses are canceled. The preceding targeting-sequence explanation is a ruling. The later Appendix A PDF114 also changes Mentor/Apprentice One of your... to Your... . Original face: [[:File:Dagobah-L-greatwarrior-decipher-archive.gif]]. The Supplement does not replace Mentor/Apprentice or the entire test. The intermediate retains the original targeting, completion threshold and Mentor/Apprentice clauses; [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Players Committee, SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A (edition dated 30 July 2023)]], PDF p. 114. supplies the later full state. Its exact title/data disposition is coordinated with Story 617.
